description: This file is a CLI script for the 'universalinit' project, providing command-line interface functions to initialize various project types, parse parameters, handle command-line arguments, and output configuration details in JSON format.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a parameter string formatted as key=value pairs separated by commas into a dictionary with proper data types.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments, including parsed parameters and project type.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig object with default values, primarily for retrieving template info.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on the given base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary suitable for JSON serialization, converting init files to absolute paths.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Outputs a JSON-formatted result indicating success or failure, message, and optionally the template configuration.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs a JSON containing the project type and its associated run command.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles retrieval of the run command for a given project type by creating a minimal config and template, with error handling.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Entry point for the CLI, parsing arguments, handling project initialization or get-run-command requests, and printing output.

ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
